about.title: A botanical business with roots in 1986
about.description: ZL Botanicals traces its company history to 1986 in Guangzhou. Today, our catalog helps business buyers explore botanical extracts and natural ingredients. Manufacturing site, sourcing route and available documents should be confirmed for each product and specification.

products.title: Our Product Range
products.botanicalDesc: Compare botanical identity, assay and test methods for your target specification.
products.herbalDesc: Botanical powders for evaluation by plant part, particle size and application.
products.customDesc: Discuss target composition and processing requirements; feasibility is confirmed per project.

whyUs.subtitle: A clearer purchasing process
whyUs.title: From ingredient shortlist to purchase review
whyUs.gmpDesc: Request the specification, representative COA and any required certificates. Check product and site scope, issuer and validity.
whyUs.traceabilityDesc: Confirm botanical identity, plant part, origin and manufacturing site for the material being quoted.
whyUs.pricingDesc: Share target assay, carrier, order quantity and destination so quotations can be evaluated on the same basis.
whyUs.moqDesc: Ask about sample availability, quantity, fees and shipping before planning your evaluation.
whyUs.rdDesc: Assess taste, color, solubility and stability in your own process. Application ideas are starting points, not performance guarantees.
whyUs.turnaroundDesc: Confirm MOQ, lead time, packaging, shelf life and required release documents in the quotation before ordering.

cta.title: Move your ingredient shortlist forward
cta.subtitle: Send the ingredient, target specification, application, destination and expected volume. Ask for sample availability and a representative COA; confirm batch documents before shipment.
